gloss: blunder; carelessness; being caught off guard

definitions.gloss: blunder; carelessness; being caught off guard
definitions.explanation: A failure or mistake caused by lack of vigilance or awareness. Often used to describe a moment of uncharacteristic weakness or an embarrassing lapse.

examples.japanese: {不覚|ふかく}にも{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: I shed tears before I knew it.

examples.japanese: {不覚|ふかく}にも{電車|でんしゃ}で{寝過|ねす}ごしてしまった。
examples.english: I carelessly slept past my stop on the train.

examples.japanese: あんな{簡単|かんたん}な{問題|もんだい}を{間違|まちが}えるとは{不覚|ふかく}だった。
examples.english: Getting such an easy question wrong was a careless blunder.

notes:
{不覚|ふかく} literally means "not being aware" ({不|ふ} + {覚|かく}). It is commonly used in the set phrase {不覚|ふかく}にも, meaning "inadvertently" or "before I realized it."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不覚|ふかく}にも～ (inadvertently; before I knew it)
- ～とは{不覚|ふかく}だった (it was careless that...)
- {不覚|ふかく}を{取|と}る (to be caught off guard; to make a blunder)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不覚|ふかく}にも{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た (tears came before I could stop them)
- {不覚|ふかく}を{取|と}る (to be defeated by carelessness)

USAGE:
The phrase {不覚|ふかく}にも{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た is a very common expression meaning someone was unexpectedly moved to tears — implying that crying was not intended and somewhat embarrassing.
